local_land_claim_visualization_radius.title: Land-claim debug radius
local_land_claim_visualization_radius.description: Radius around the player used to collect the land-claim debug display. It does not set the building land-claim radius.

use_local_quadratic_angular_velocity_pre.title: Predict replicated character rotation
use_local_quadratic_angular_velocity_pre.description: Predicts character rotation from recent rotation samples and applies the prediction duration, fade and rotation-smoothing settings.

lqavp_use_time.title: Angular-velocity prediction duration (seconds)
lqavp_use_time.description: Time at full prediction strength before the separate fade period begins.

lqavp_fade_time.title: Angular-velocity prediction fade time (seconds)
lqavp_fade_time.description: Time over which prediction strength falls to zero after the prediction duration ends.

lqavp_method.title: Rotation prediction method
lqavp_method.description: 0 applies no correction; 1 divides angular error by the update duration; 2 uses angular error directly; 3 uses the derivative of the prediction curve.

network_simulated_smooth_rotation_time_w.title: Predicted rotation smoothing time (seconds)
network_simulated_smooth_rotation_time_w.description: With angular-velocity prediction enabled, this sets how long clients interpolate toward the server-corrected rotation.

enable_clan_markers.title: Clan map markers
enable_clan_markers.description: Show clan markers on the map.

validate_player_stats.title: Validate player attribute points
validate_player_stats.description: Checks attribute-point spending against the points allowed for the character level. Excess allocation resets the attribute points and notifies the player.

storm_endurance_drain_multiplier.description: Scale mounted stamina drain inside a Maelstrom. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] StormEnduranceDrainMultiplier.

storm_building_allowed.description: Allow construction inside the Maelstrom. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] StormBuildingAllowed.

storm_building_damage_rate_multiplier.description: Increase this value to apply Maelstrom building damage more frequently. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] StormBuildingDamageRateMultiplier.

elder_things_enabled.description: Allow Elder Things to spawn and attack players during the Maelstrom. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] ElderThingsEnabled.

elder_things_idle_lifespan.title: Creature Idle Lifetime (minutes)
elder_things_idle_lifespan.description: Time an Elder Thing remains outside combat before disappearing. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] ElderThingsIdleLifespan.

elder_thing_spawn_rate.title: Creature Spawn Rate
elder_thing_spawn_rate.description: Scale the rate of Elder Thing spawns during the Maelstrom. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] ElderThingSpawnRate.

max_ambush_elder_things.title: Maximum Ambush Creatures
max_ambush_elder_things.description: Maximum Elder Things spawned to attack players during the Maelstrom. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] MaxAmbushElderThings.

siege_elder_things_enabled.title: Enable Siege Creatures
siege_elder_things_enabled.description: Allow siege Elder Things to attack buildings during the Maelstrom. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] SiegeElderThingsEnabled.

max_siege_elder_things.title: Maximum Siege Creatures
max_siege_elder_things.description: Maximum siege Elder Things that may attack buildings. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] MaxSiegeElderThings.

siege_elder_thing_respawn_rate.title: Siege Creature Spawn Rate
siege_elder_thing_respawn_rate.description: Scale the rate of siege creature spawns. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] SiegeElderThingRespawnRate.

siege_elder_thing_map_markers.title: Show Siege Creatures on Map
siege_elder_thing_map_markers.description: Display map markers for siege Elder Things. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] SiegeElderThingMapMarkers.

minimum_building_size_to_be_sieged.title: Siege Building Size Threshold
minimum_building_size_to_be_sieged.description: Buildings must exceed this piece count before siege creatures target them. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] MinimumBuildingSizeToBeSieged.

elder_thing_siege_building_size_multipli.title: Siege Attraction Size Multiplier
elder_thing_siege_building_size_multipli.description: Higher values let smaller buildings attract larger siege creatures. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] ElderThingSiegeBuildingSizeMultiplier.

elder_thing_siege_damage_multiplier.title: Siege Creature Building Damage
elder_thing_siege_damage_multiplier.description: Scale damage dealt by Elder Things to structures. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] ElderThingSiegeDamageMultiplier.

surge_despawn_timer.title: Surge Despawn Delay (minutes)
surge_despawn_timer.description: Time before an unfinished Surge disappears. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] SurgeDespawnTimer.

surge_sacrifice_requirement_multiplier.title: Surge Resource Cost Multiplier
surge_sacrifice_requirement_multiplier.description: Scale the resources required to reach Surge power levels. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] SurgeSacrificeRequirementMultiplier.

altar_module_active_time_multiplier.title: Leyshrine Defense Duration
altar_module_active_time_multiplier.description: Scale the active duration of Leyshrine palisades and shutters. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] AltarModuleActiveTimeMultiplier.

vault_refresh_time.title: Vault Refresh Interval (minutes)
vault_refresh_time.description: Time before a visited Vault can repopulate. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] VaultRefreshTime.

vault_refresh_deviation.title: Vault Refresh Variation (minutes)
vault_refresh_deviation.description: Random time added to or subtracted from the Vault refresh interval. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] VaultRefreshDeviation.

player_active_hunger_multiplier.title: Active Hunger Multiplier
player_active_hunger_multiplier.description: Scale food depletion while a player is active. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] PlayerActiveHungerMultiplier.

player_active_thirst_multiplier.title: Active Thirst Multiplier
player_active_thirst_multiplier.description: Scale water depletion while a player is active. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] PlayerActiveThirstMultiplier.

player_idle_hunger_multiplier.title: Idle Hunger Multiplier
player_idle_hunger_multiplier.description: Scale food depletion while a player is idle. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] PlayerIdleHungerMultiplier.

player_idle_thirst_multiplier.title: Idle Thirst Multiplier
player_idle_thirst_multiplier.description: Scale water depletion while a player is idle. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] PlayerIdleThirstMultiplier.

logout_characters_remain_in_the_world.title: Keep Logged-out Characters in World
logout_characters_remain_in_the_world.description: Keep logged-out characters as unconscious bodies in the world. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] LogoutCharactersRemainInTheWorld.

is_load_errors_fatal.title: Stop on Persistence Load Error
is_load_errors_fatal.description: Stop the native server when its persistent world cannot load correctly. Native: ServerSettings.ini [ServerSettings] IsLoadErrorsFatal.

override_decay_max_building_pieces.title: Small-building decay piece threshold
override_decay_max_building_pieces.description: Buildings with no more than this many pieces use the fixed small-building decay time, unless a placeable is attached. Building abandonment must be enabled.

override_decay_time.title: Small-building decay time (seconds)
override_decay_time.description: Fixed decay lifetime for buildings below the piece threshold. The abandoned state lasts 10% of this time.

drop_equipment_on_death.title: Items dropped on death
drop_equipment_on_death.description: Choose whether death drops all items, only backpack contents, or nothing. Corpse looting permissions are configured separately.

player_offline_hunger_multiplier.title: Offline hunger consumption multiplier
player_offline_hunger_multiplier.description: Scale food depletion while a character has no controller. Zero stops offline food depletion.

player_offline_thirst_multiplier.title: Offline thirst consumption multiplier
player_offline_thirst_multiplier.description: Scale water depletion while a character has no controller. Zero stops offline water depletion.

player_water_multiplier.title: Drinking recovery multiplier
player_water_multiplier.description: Multiply the water restored when consuming a drink or drinking from a water source. This does not change the rate of thirst depletion.

shield_durability_multiplier.title: Blocking durability loss multiplier
shield_durability_multiplier.description: Multiply durability lost when a shield takes a hit or a weapon blocks. This combines with the overall durability multiplier; higher values cause faster wear.

disabled_knowledge_ids.title: Disabled knowledge IDs
disabled_knowledge_ids.description: Enter numeric knowledge IDs as a quoted array, such as ("1","2"). Use () for no exclusions. Duplicate IDs have no additional effect.

enable_building_destruction_capsules.title: Map capsule cleanup regions
enable_building_destruction_capsules.description: Enable the map's capsule-shaped cleanup regions. They can destroy buildings and placed objects within these regions; this is separate from normal building damage rules.

storm_time_weekday_start.title: Weekday storm start (HHMM)
storm_time_weekday_start.description: Use server local time as HHMM, for example 1830 for 18:30. The interval includes its start and excludes its end. Set the start earlier than the end; an interval cannot cross midnight.

storm_time_weekday_end.title: Weekday storm end (HHMM)
storm_time_weekday_end.description: Use server local time as HHMM, for example 1830 for 18:30. The interval includes its start and excludes its end. Set the start earlier than the end; an interval cannot cross midnight.

storm_time_weekend_start.title: Weekend storm start (HHMM)
storm_time_weekend_start.description: Use server local time as HHMM, for example 1830 for 18:30. The interval includes its start and excludes its end. Set the start earlier than the end; an interval cannot cross midnight.

storm_time_weekend_end.title: Weekend storm end (HHMM)
storm_time_weekend_end.description: Use server local time as HHMM, for example 1830 for 18:30. The interval includes its start and excludes its end. Set the start earlier than the end; an interval cannot cross midnight.

action_stamina_cost_multiplier.title: Attack, jump and dodge stamina cost
action_stamina_cost_multiplier.description: Multiply stamina spent on attacks, jumps and dodges. Sprinting has its own stamina cost setting.

enable_ban_check.title: Check authentication-service ban status
enable_ban_check.description: Reject login when the authentication response reports IsBanned. Individual player bans and allowlists are managed separately.
